faq.subtitle: Everything you want to know before getting started.
faq.q1: How does Aptely verify candidate skills?
faq.a1: Aptely analyzes candidates' Capability Records — structured files including concrete projects, GitHub contributions, certifications, and contextual feedback from previous managers. The AI cross-references this data with the role requirements to produce a verified, non-self-declared skills score.
faq.q2: What types of roles is Aptely suited for?
faq.a2: Aptely is designed for tech and digital profiles: developers (front, back, fullstack), DevOps, data, product, UX/UI design, and technical managers. Our database covers more than 150 specific roles with dedicated evaluation grids.
faq.a3: Our AI simultaneously analyzes the candidate profile and the role requirements (stack, seniority, team dynamics, culture). It produces an overall score with sub-scores per dimension, and generates a text explanation for each decision — not a black box.
faq.q4: Are my HR and candidate data secure?
faq.a4: Yes. Aptely is hosted in Europe (Supabase EU), GDPR-compliant, and uses encryption at rest and in transit. Candidate data is never used to train third-party models. You remain the owner of your data at all times.
faq.q5: What is the difference with LinkedIn Recruiter?
faq.a5: LinkedIn shows you profiles. Aptely tells you why a profile fits — or not — your specific role, with verifiable proof. No self-marketing, no presentation bias. We complement LinkedIn: import your leads, Aptely analyzes them in depth.

privacy.intro: At Aptely, protecting your personal and professional data is our absolute priority. Discover how we handle your information with transparency and security.
privacy.s1.title: 1. Introduction
privacy.s1.body: Aptely ("we", "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of users of its recruitment platform. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it and your rights regarding this data.
privacy.s2.title: 2. Use of Google API data
privacy.s2.intro: Aptely uses the Google Calendar API only to schedule interviews. We request only strictly necessary access and limit processing to user-triggered actions.
privacy.s2.scope1desc: — Reading availability (FreeBusy endpoint) to avoid scheduling conflicts. We do not read the content of events.
privacy.s2.scope2desc: — Creating an interview event in the primary calendar and generating the Google Meet link via the built-in conferencing.
privacy.s2.processed1: Busy slots of the primary calendar.
privacy.s2.processed2: Interview title, time, duration and participant list that you provide.
privacy.s2.processed3: Generated Google Meet link and associated event identifier.
privacy.s2.storagePre: We do not store the content of your other private events. OAuth tokens are encrypted and kept only to maintain the active connection. We
privacy.s2.storagePost: share your calendar data with third parties for advertising purposes.
privacy.s2.policyNotePre: Aptely's use of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the
privacy.s2.policyLink: Google API Services User Data Policy
privacy.s3.title: 3. Data security
privacy.s3.body: All data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We use standard protocols (OAuth 2.0) so you never have to share your Google or Outlook password with us.
privacy.s4.title: 4. Retention
privacy.s4.body: Access tokens are kept as long as the integration is active. You can revoke access at any time from your Aptely account settings or from your Google account.
privacy.footer.title: A question about your data?

calendar.howItWorks.title: How the calendar works
calendar.howItWorks.intro: The Aptely calendar syncs with Cal.com to unify your interview schedule and personal availability in one place. No more double-booking or manual updates.
calendar.howItWorks.why.title: Why connect Cal.com?
calendar.howItWorks.why.body: Cal.com is your scheduling layer. When linked to Aptely, every interview you schedule appears on your Cal.com dashboard automatically. Candidates receive a booking link to pick a time slot from your real availability — no emails, no back-and-forth. You stay in control, they get a frictionless experience.
calendar.howItWorks.flow.title: Full workflow
calendar.howItWorks.flow.step1: You create a job post → candidates apply → you schedule an interview from the candidate's page (choose date, time, duration, interviewers).
calendar.howItWorks.flow.step2: The interview lands on this calendar and on your Cal.com. An email goes to the candidate with the meeting link and details.
calendar.howItWorks.flow.step3: The interview syncs both ways. If you reschedule in Aptely, Cal.com updates. Everything stays aligned without manual work.
calendar.howItWorks.flow.step4: After the interview, use the scorecards, AI summary, and decision buttons right from the interview detail page — all linked from this calendar.
calendar.howItWorks.setup.title: How to connect Cal.com?
calendar.howItWorks.setup.step1: Go to https://cal.com and sign in (or create an account if you don't have one). In Cal.com, link the calendars (Google, Outlook...) you want to sync.
calendar.howItWorks.setup.step2: In Cal.com, go to Settings → My Profile. Copy your username (the part after "cal.com/").
calendar.howItWorks.setup.step3: Back in the Aptely calendar, click "Edit", paste your username and click "Connect".
calendar.howItWorks.setup.conclusion: ✅ Congrats! Your Aptely calendar is synced with Cal.com. All interviews scheduled on Aptely will automatically appear in the calendars you linked to Cal.com.

roles.gate.title: Job title
roles.gate.title_modal: Complete the job sheet before publishing
roles.gate.explanation: Candidates will see this information. Please fill in the following fields in the job sheet:
roles.tip.title: Be specific: include the role, specialty and level. E.g. 'Lead Backend Engineer — Payments'. Our AI uses this title for matching.
roles.tip.mission90: Describe what this person must deliver in their first 90 days. Be concrete: deliverables, metrics, expected outcomes.
roles.tip.success6m: How will you know this hire is a success after 6 months? KPIs, goals achieved, team impact.
roles.tip.problems: Select and rank problems by priority. Selection order defines rank (1 = most important). AI uses this ranking to prioritize skills.
roles.tip.ownership: Rate from 1 (low) to 5 (high) the expected level for each dimension. AI compares these levels to candidate profiles for matching.
roles.tip.skills: Each skill has a weight in AI matching. 'Core' = mandatory, 'Important' = heavily weighted, 'Nice' = bonus. Add as many skills as needed.
roles.tip.culture: Position sliders according to your team culture. This data helps AI evaluate candidate cultural fit.
roles.tip.dealbreakers: Absolute exclusion criteria. A candidate showing these traits will be automatically downranked by AI.
roles.tip.salary: Gross annual amount. Choose the currency matching the job country. This range is used for candidate matching and filtering.
roles.tip.ai: Custom questions will be shown to candidates. AI context is secret — it guides automatic evaluation without being visible to candidates.
